Native PowerPoint reference crops, captured October 19, 2026 with Computer Use.
Source: presentation-2_5aD3Wgt (1).pptx, the same deck as marketing-fonts.pptx
(SHA256 2d8838b1e0d9b05868296e61fa0b90552cc2fcaffd1c828b61bb6492f2b8a49f).

Each PNG is a lossless crop of the recorded native PowerPoint screenshot.
The input screenshots were JPEG; their SHA256s are in regions.json. The native
slide canvas starts at screenshot (357,166) and measures 1140 x 641 pixels.
Each region's rectangle is relative to that canvas. No resizing, recoloring,
font substitution, or layout edits were applied to the reference images.

PowerPoint is the source of truth. Source overlaps are deliberately excluded.
The regression compares per-line ink centers at the same 1140px canvas width,
not whole-slide pixel equality. The 1.75px tolerance accommodates the different
CoreGraphics/JPEG and Chrome/PNG rasterization paths. Before the leading fix,
slides 12 and 14 differed by about 2.9px. The slide 6 text-coverage check also
guards against replacing regular text with artificial bold as a visual patch.

Run: yarn test:pptx-fonts --runInBand
Do not regenerate these images from browser output. New references must come
from PowerPoint and the source/hash/region metadata must be updated with them.
